:::{#sol-matadd-inverse-proof}

Both sides are $m \times n$ [matrices](#def-matrix),
so they are [equal](#def-matrix-equality) when their $(i, j)$ entries agree for every $i$ and $j$.
For each $i$ and $j$,

$$
\ba
(\matr{A} + (-\matr{A}))_{ij}
&= a_{ij} + (-\matr{A})_{ij}
&& \text{(@def-matrix-addition)}
\\
&= a_{ij} + (-a_{ij})
&& \text{(definition of } -\matr{A} \text{ in @thm-matadd-inverse)}
\\
&= 0
&& \text{(a number plus its negative is } 0 \text{)}
\\
&= (\matr{0}_{m \times n})_{ij}.
&& \text{(@def-zero-matrix)}
\ea
$$

So $\matr{A} + (-\matr{A}) = \matr{0}_{m \times n}$.

:::
